title: 01. Foundations: INDEXING (Offline — Done Once)
summary: INDEXING (Offline — Done Once): explanations and runnable examples.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```
YOUR DOCUMENTS (PDFs, Word, HTML, etc.)
              │
              ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│         DOCUMENT LOADER             │
│  PDF → text extraction              │
│  HTML → clean text                  │
│  Word → paragraphs                  │
│  CSV → rows                         │
└──────────────┬──────────────────────┘
               │
               ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│         TEXT CLEANER                │
│  Remove headers/footers             │
│  Fix encoding issues                │
│  Remove boilerplate                 │
│  Normalize whitespace               │
└──────────────┬──────────────────────┘
               │
               ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│         CHUNKER                     │
│  Split large documents into         │
│  smaller pieces                     │
│                                     │
│  Strategy:                          │
│  - Fixed size: every 512 tokens     │
│  - Semantic: split at meaning       │
│  - Recursive: try paragraph → sent  │
│  - Overlap: 50 token overlap        │
│    between chunks                   │
└──────────────┬──────────────────────┘
               │
               ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│         EMBEDDER                    │
│  Each chunk → vector representation │
│                                     │
│  "Our refund policy allows..."      │
│     → [0.23, -0.45, 0.87, ...]     │
│        (1536 numbers)               │
└──────────────┬──────────────────────┘
               │
               ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│         VECTOR DATABASE             │
│  Store: embedding + text + metadata │
│                                     │
│  {                                  │
│    "id": "chunk_001",               │
│    "embedding": [0.23, -0.45,...],  │
│    "text": "Our refund policy...",  │
│    "metadata": {                    │
│      "source": "policy_v2.pdf",     │
│      "page": 3,                     │
│      "section": "Refund Policy",    │
│      "date": "2025-01-15",          │
│      "category": "policy"           │
│    }                                │
│  }                                  │
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
```
